correctness.rationale: For all a,b>-1/2 and c>0, the pointwise binomial expansion is justified by Cauchy–Schwarz. Two orthogonal radial monomial systems produce an exact SVD and beta/gamma singular values. Gamma asymptotics establish boundedness, compactness, Schatten and essential-norm endpoints; the exact one-step ratio and strict AM–GM establish every maximizing order and nonattainment. Pure-Python tests check algebraic indexing and integral normalization but do not stand in for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural full two-sided Forelli–Rudin family has a sharp and explicitly calculable three-parameter norm, with a genuinely asymmetric infinite staircase of extremizing Fourier modes and a nonattained critical norm. The complete singular spectrum and sharp Schatten boundary are independent useful spectral invariants; unlike a routine symmetric substitution, asymmetry introduces a geometric-mean onset and arithmetic-mean accumulation that explain distinct Hilbert-space behavior.
